newsitem.title: USA: Leak-X Environmental sets reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Leak-X Environmental sets reverse split.

text.p: Leak-X Environmental Corp said Tuesday it had set a one-for-13 reverse stock split.

The company said the reverse split, expected to be completed by mid-February, will allow it to remain in compliance with the listing criteria of the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, which requires a closing bid price equal to or greater than $1 per share.
Leak-X provides environmental engineering, hydrogeological and remedial consulting services.
